summary:
Here is a 3-sentence summary of the child's part of the interview:

The child has been attending workshops and outings with other kids who stutter, which has helped them make connections and feel more comfortable with their stuttering. They have learned that everyone reacts and copes with stuttering differently and that it's okay to have a lower fluency rate in stressful situations. The child feels that they have benefited from a speech therapist who focused on acceptance and self-advocacy, and they believe that this approach is more effective than traditional fluency-based therapy.
